origins.section: The Cost of a Decision Is What the Best Plan Loses When You Force the Opposite
A Forcing the Rules Cannot Satisfy Is Answered by a Rule, Not a Price
Report Every Project, and Read Small Costs as Near Ties

gates.says: all 3 of this quiz's answerable readings held and each was taken over the question as it stands

recorded.prompt:q-worth: Read the whole lesson page, then this question. Using only what the page states, which option does the page decide is correct? Quote or cite the deciding passage.
recorded.outcome:q-worth: Delta_out(i) = z* - z*_out(i) gives 30,000 - 29,850 = 150. Also: "its ... money does not vanish: the re-solve spends it on P002, P036..."
recorded.prompt:q-infeasible: Read the whole lesson page, then this question. Using only what the page states, which option does the page decide is correct? Quote or cite the deciding passage.
recorded.outcome:q-infeasible: "Forcing a must-do out is infeasible; report the rows in conflict, never a number."
recorded.prompt:q-near-tie: Read the whole lesson page, then this question. Using only what the page states, which option does the page decide is correct? Quote or cite the deciding passage.
recorded.outcome:q-near-tie: "Treat a small cost as a finding in its own right. It says the decision is cheap to override". Also: "small against the NPV | a near tie".

recorded.prompt:q-worth:a: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-worth:a: "Neither number is the project's own NPV". Also: "P032 brings $3,678k of NPV, yet losing it costs only $112k".
recorded.prompt:q-worth:b: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-worth:b: The cost is defined as "Delta_out(i) = z* - z*_out(i)", the loss, not the forced plan's value.
recorded.prompt:q-worth:c: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-worth:c: Delta_out = z* - z*_out = $150k by the page's formula. NPV minus that loss is not what the page defines.
recorded.prompt:q-infeasible:b: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-infeasible:b: "the cost is not 'very large' but undefined"
recorded.prompt:q-infeasible:c: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-infeasible:c: "A report must say 'infeasible: must_P017', never print a number." The cost is undefined, not zero.
recorded.prompt:q-infeasible:d: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-infeasible:d: "never print a number". Reference table: "undefined | the forcing breaks a rule; name the rule".
recorded.prompt:q-near-tie:a: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-near-tie:a: "P004 is not out because it is a bad project; it is out because a plan with it exists that is only $64k worse"
recorded.prompt:q-near-tie:b: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-near-tie:b: "Ten different reversals lead to just two plans ... the solver must pick one". The page treats close rivals as normal runner-up plans, not as solver unreliability.
recorded.prompt:q-near-tie:d: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-near-tie:d: Reference reads a small cost as "a near tie; cheap to override, and sensitive to inputs", not as a model error.
